capabilities.description: Generates MP4 video clips from prompts and character reference plates.
Creates character reference portraits and book plate graphics.
Screenplay reasoning, shot planning, and cast analysis.
Book page OCR, cast-on-image classification, and frame inspection.
Evaluates dialogue, lip sync, and scene rhythm (Google Gemini natively analyzes MP4 video files).
Generates beat-aligned background music scores and sound effects.
Personal voice clone from a short sample, then spoken dialogue or narration for the film.
Resyncs a generated clip's mouth movement to a separate dialogue or narration audio track.
Prompt-based edit of an already-generated clip (re-render an action, color, or detail from a text instruction).
Turns spoken audio into text with word timings for dialogue checks.

Direct MiniMax pay-as-you-go video at platform.minimax.io (not the Fal-hosted MiniMax voice models). Official id MiniMax-H3-Max. Text-to-video, image-to-video (first and/or last frame), and reference generation. Reference mode accepts up to 3 audio clips for voice lock (2-15s each, 15s total) that preserve speaker identity, up to 9 reference images (character/look lock), and up to 3 reference videos (guide motion/style only; 2-15s each, 15s total). Mixed reference input is capped at 12 files. There is no true extend: this model cannot continue an existing clip from its last frame, so longer scenes must be stitched from separate clips. Duration is 5-15 seconds, integers only (4s is not supported). Output is 480P or 768P (2K is not supported). Text-to-video requires an explicit ratio and cannot use adaptive. Disabled because no IVideoClient is registered for providerId minimax, so selecting this model would fail at generation time. Awaits the MiniMax provider integration and MINIMAX_API_KEY. Do not enable until that client exists: ModelProviderFamily has no MiniMax member, so the deserialized Provider family falls back to Xai and key checks would treat this row as xAI.
